name: zclass_world_init_virtual_area_partitions
description: zClass_World::InitVirtualAreaPartitions moves children from occupied virtual-area edge cells into generated VAP_statics object nodes, then reinserts those statics nodes into the world.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4502b0 validates the null areaGridRows error path, UpdateQueuedTrees prepass, top-row, bottom-row, left-edge, and right-edge sweeps, VAP_statics object creation, moving first child from each occupied edge cell through gwObject3DAddChild and RemoveChildAtGrid until empty, UpdateQueuedTrees, AddChildAtGrid, and return 0.
The native smoke verifies the null-grid error path and an enabled virtual-partition pass that moves an edge-cell child under a generated VAP_statics node while emptying the original grid cell.
